kurals.tr: Penniyalaar Ellaarum Kannin Podhuunpar / Nannen Paraththanin Maarpu
kurals.m: You are given to prostitution; all those who are born as womankind enjoy you with their eyes in an ordinary way I will not embrace you

kurals.tr: Ooti Irundhemaath Thumminaar Yaamdhammai / Neetuvaazh Kenpaak Karindhu
kurals.m: When I continued to be sulky he sneezed and thought I would (then) wish him a long life

kurals.tr: Kottup Pooch Chootinum Kaayum / Oruththiyaik Kaattiya Sootineer Endru
kurals.m: Even if I were adorned with a garland of branch-flowers, she would say I did so to show it to another woman

kurals.tr: Yaarinum Kaadhalam Endrenaa Ootinaal / Yaarinum Yaarinum Endru
kurals.m: When I said I loved her more than any other woman, she said "more than others, yes, more than others," and remained sulky

kurals.tr: Immaip Pirappil Piriyalam Endrenaak / Kannirai Neerkon Tanal
kurals.m: When I said I would never part from her in this life her eyes were filled with tears

kurals.tr: Ullinen Endrenmar Renmarandheer Endrennaip / Pullaal Pulaththak Kanal
kurals.m: When I said I had remembered her, she said I had forgotten her and relaxing her embrace, began to feign dislike

kurals.tr: Vazhuththinaal Thumminen Aaka Azhiththazhudhaal / Yaarullith Thummineer Endru
kurals.m: When I sneezed she blessed me, but at once changed (her mind) and wept, asking, "At the thought of whom did you sneeze?"

kurals.tr: Thummuch Cheruppa Azhudhaal Numarullal / Emmai Maraiththiro Endru
kurals.m: When I suppressed my sneezing, she wept saying, "I suppose you (did so) to hide from me your own people's remembrance of you"

kurals.tr: Thannai Unarththinum Kaayum Pirarkkumneer / Inneerar Aakudhir Endru
kurals.m: 'I see', quoth she, 'to other folks How you are wondrous kind' Even when I try to remove her dislike, she is displeased and says, "This is the way you behave

kurals.tr: Ninaiththirundhu Nokkinum Kaayum Anaiththuneer / Yaarulli Nokkineer Endru
kurals.m: Even when I look on her contemplating (her beauty), she is displeased and says, "With whose thought have you (thus) looked on my person?"
